import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
n = 1000
k = rng.integers(0, 2, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (2, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['label'] = [f'cls_{v}' for v in k]

steps.name: compute anchor screen position
steps.eval: const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const sc = a.renderer.projectWorld(a.anchorXY[0], a.anchorXY[1]); window.__sx0 = Math.round(r.left + sc[0]); window.__sy0 = Math.round(r.top + sc[1]);

steps.name: draw a rectangle centered on data
steps.drag: (() => { const x0 = window.__sx0 - 60; const y0 = window.__sy0 - 50; return [[x0, y0], [x0+120, y0+100]]; })()
steps.report: { w: a.shapes[0].w, h: a.shapes[0].h, rotation: a.shapes[0].rotation }

steps.name: compute BR corner screen position
steps.eval: const rect = a.shapes[0]; const sc = a.renderer.projectWorld(rect.x + rect.w, rect.y); window.__brX = Math.round(document.querySelector('canvas').getBoundingClientRect().left + sc[0]); window.__brY = Math.round(document.querySelector('canvas').getBoundingClientRect().top + sc[1]); window.__origW = rect.w; window.__origH = rect.h;

steps.name: resize rect by dragging BR handle outward (Shift for aspect ratio)
steps.report: { wBefore: window.__origW, wAfter: a.shapes[0].w, hBefore: window.__origH, hAfter: a.shapes[0].h }

steps.name: compute rotate handle position (above top edge)
steps.eval: const rect = a.shapes[0]; const cx = rect.x + rect.w/2; const topY = rect.y + rect.h; const rotOffsetWorld = 20 * a.renderer.worldPerPixel(); const rsc = a.renderer.projectWorld(cx, topY + rotOffsetWorld); const r = document.querySelector('canvas').getBoundingClientRect(); window.__rhX2 = Math.round(r.left + rsc[0]); window.__rhY2 = Math.round(r.top + rsc[1]); window.__origRotation = rect.rotation;

steps.name: rotate rect by dragging rotate handle
add a second shape for front/back order test
steps.eval: const ref = a.shapes[0]; const s = { kind: 'rect', id: 'rect-b', x: ref.x + 1, y: ref.y + 1, w: ref.w, h: ref.h, rotation: 0, style: { ...ref.style }, selected: false }; a.addShape(s);

steps.name: select second shape (rect-b) and send to back
steps.eval: const id = a.shapes.find(s => s.id === 'rect-b')?.id; if (id) { a.shapesSelectedId = id; a.sendToBack(id); }

steps.name: bring to front
steps.eval: const id = a.shapes.find(s => s.id === 'rect-b')?.id; if (id) a.bringToFront(id);

steps.name: draw a polygon for vertex editing
steps.eval: const wx = a.anchorXY[0], wy = a.anchorXY[1]; const wpp = a.renderer.worldPerPixel() * 20; const poly = { kind: 'polygon', id: 'poly-v', vertices: [[wx-wpp, wy-wpp], [wx+wpp, wy-wpp], [wx, wy+wpp]], rotation: 0, style: { strokeColor: [0,200,80,220], fillColor: [0,200,80,40], strokeWidth: 2, opacity: 1, dash: [], arrowHead: 'none' }, selected: false }; a.addShape(poly);

steps.name: move a polygon vertex via updateShape
steps.eval: const poly = a.shapes.find(s => s.id === 'poly-v'); if (poly) { const verts = [...poly.vertices]; const delta = a.renderer.worldPerPixel() * 15; verts[2] = [verts[2][0] + delta, verts[2][1] + delta]; window.__origVert2 = poly.vertices[2].slice(); a.updateShape('poly-v', { vertices: verts }); }

steps.name: draw an arrow and check arrowhead in PNG export
steps.eval: const wx = a.anchorXY[0], wy = a.anchorXY[1]; const wpp = a.renderer.worldPerPixel() * 40; const arr = { kind: 'arrow', id: 'arr-png', points: [[wx - wpp, wy], [wx + wpp, wy]], rotation: 0, style: { strokeColor: [255, 60, 0, 255], fillColor: [255, 60, 0, 60], strokeWidth: 3, opacity: 1, dash: [], arrowHead: 'end' }, selected: false }; a.addShape(arr);

steps.name: verify arrowhead pixels in PNG export
steps.eval: const arr = a.shapes.find(s => s.id === 'arr-png'); const tipPt = arr.points[arr.points.length - 1]; const sc = a.renderer.projectWorld(tipPt[0], tipPt[1]); const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const dpr = img.width / document.querySelector('canvas').getBoundingClientRect().width; const px = Math.round((sc[0]) * dpr), py = Math.round((sc[1]) * dpr); let redPixels = 0; for (let dx = -20; dx <= 5; dx++) for (let dy = -15; dy <= 15; dy++) { const d = g.getImageData(px+dx, py+dy, 1, 1).data; if (d[0] > 180 && d[1] < 100 && d[3] > 100) redPixels++; } window.__arrowPixels = redPixels;
